component.name: Leather Client
component.summary: A performance-focused Minecraft launcher and client

description.p: Leather Client makes it easy to play Minecraft with automatically managed performance mods and useful screen tools from one launcher.
Create and manage instances, install the required Java runtime, sign in with Microsoft, and keep supported client components up to date.

screenshot.caption: Leather Client's instance and launch interface

ul.li: Added the Leather Network support-ticket inbox.
Improved support conversations and account-consent handling.
